data.name: Naseeba
data.gender_notes: Naseeba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘n-s-b’, Naseeba means ‘destined’, ‘preordained’, or ‘fated’. In Islamic tradition, the concept of Qadar encompasses the belief that Allah (God) has predestined all things, including the lives and destinies of individuals. Naseeba, therefore, symbolizes submission to the divine plan. The name Naseeba carries the meaning “Destiny, Fate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naseeba usually hope their child will grow to embody destiny, fate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naseeba total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
